description: This file defines a class for access control checks related to workflow state and transition operations within Drupal, implementing access logic based on route parameters and workflow states.

classes.name: WorkflowStateTransitionOperationsAccessCheck
classes.description: A class that implements access control for workflow state and transition operations in Drupal.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks if a user has access to perform a workflow state or transition operation based on route parameters and workflow permissions.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Retrieves the specific workflow operation required for access checking from the route match.
